title: Entanglement path budget
description: Explore how probabilistic link generation, swapping, memory lifetime, and optional purification affect one end-to-end Bell pair.
modelNote: This is a transparent teaching model, not a hardware forecast. It assumes independent identical links, Werner-state fidelity, exponential memory decay, concurrent elementary-link attempts, and one BBPSSW-style purification round. Real protocols require platform-specific discrete-event or experimental validation.

schedules.label: Same-round generation
schedules.detail: All elementary links must succeed in the same attempt window. Memory waits less, but path success multiplies across links.

schedules.label: Buffer successful links
schedules.detail: Keep successful pairs while slower links retry. Yield improves, but the oldest memory accumulates decoherence.

purificationModes.label: Deliver the raw swapped pair
purificationModes.detail: Preserve pair yield and accept the fidelity left after links, swaps, and memory decay.

purificationModes.label: One purification round
purificationModes.detail: Consume two noisy end-to-end pairs to probabilistically produce one higher-fidelity pair.

profiles.label: Short controlled links
profiles.detail: Higher per-attempt success and fidelity with a modest memory window.

profiles.label: Metro repeater experiment
profiles.detail: Lower link success, faster attempts, and a tighter memory deadline.

profiles.label: Lossy long links
profiles.detail: Rare elementary successes expose the cost of distance and waiting.
